_note: Futures and options are outside the capital-gains head: a specified derivative transaction is not speculative, so it is non-speculative business income, which this engine does not compute; a bucket it reaches is refused (W-160a, D-363). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.66(31)(a), "other than the following transactions:— (a) a specified derivative transaction as defined in clause (33)", and s.66(33), "any transaction in respect of trading in derivatives referred to in section 2 (ac) of the Securities Contracts (Regulation) Act, 1956 … carried out … electronically on screen-based systems of a recognised stock exchange" (p.103). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.43(5) proviso (d), "an eligible transaction in respect of trading in derivatives referred to in clause (ac) of section 2 of the Securities Contracts (Regulation) Act, 1956 … carried out in a recognised stock exchange" shall not be deemed speculative (thc p.237). Either way the transaction is business income, so the exchange and contract-note conditions do not change the refusal and are not conditions here. Reached by trade.transfer.segment = FUTURES or OPTIONS. Conditions only. Every regime. Sources: docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-24-speculative-transaction.md S1 – S3.
